result_summary.title: Payment Gateway v2: Webhook issues and rate limits (EU-West Prod)
result_summary.description: In our EU-West production environment, we are experiencing issues with Payment Gateway v2 where webhooks are not firing, we are exceeding rate limits, and getting timeouts. This is affecting 797 users and the business impact is high.
